hero.lead: {brand} puts your app under the spotlight: a cinematic 3D showcase in ten languages, where every sponsored listing is clearly labeled and every visitor is respected.
hero.note: Monthly plans · Cancel anytime · No visitor tracking

crowd.title: Millions of apps. Seconds of attention.
crowd.p1: App stores are crowded rooms where everyone talks at once. A store listing is not a launch. It is a seat in the back row.
crowd.p2: A premiere is different. One stage. One spotlight. Your app, presented the way it deserves to be seen.

s1.title: Submit your app
s1.text: Tell us about your app and choose a ticket. It takes a few minutes and needs no technical skills.

s2.title: We review it
s2.text: A person checks every submission against our content guidelines. Apps that mislead or harm people do not get a stage.

s3.title: Your poster goes up
s3.text: We build your listing: a cinematic poster, your tagline, and direct links to your store pages.

s4.title: Showtime, every month
s4.text: Your app stays on screen for as long as your plan is active. Change plans or cancel whenever you like.

showing.title: Now showing
showing.lead: Browse the apps on stage right now. Every listing here is a paid placement, and we say so on every poster.
showing.exampleNote: Example listings are shown for illustration only. Their names and details are fictitious, and any resemblance to real products is coincidental.
showing.empty: No apps in this category yet.
showing.error: The programme could not be loaded. Please refresh the page.
showing.noscript: Please enable JavaScript to browse the programme.

app.sponsoredNote: Sponsored listing. {brand} is paid by the publisher to show this app. We do not own, operate or endorse it.
app.exampleNote: This is an example listing created for illustration. It is not a real app and has no download link.
app.externalNote: Store links take you to websites operated by third parties.

i1.title: Ads look like ads
i1.text: Every paid placement carries a visible “Sponsored” label. No disguised advertising, ever.

i2.title: No visitor tracking
i2.text: No advertising cookies, no profiling, no data sales. The site stores only your language and privacy choices, on your own device.

i3.title: Every app is reviewed
i3.text: We check submissions by hand and remove listings that break our guidelines.

i4.title: No lock-in
i4.text: Plans renew monthly. Cancel anytime and your listing stays up until the end of the period you paid for.

tickets.title: Choose your ticket
tickets.lead: Simple monthly plans. No setup fees, no long contracts.
tickets.taxNote: Prices are in {currency}. Taxes may be added at checkout depending on your location. All listings are subject to review and to our content guidelines. We do not guarantee downloads, installs or revenue.

screening.name: Screening
screening.desc: A seat on stage for a new or growing app.
screening.f3: One link to your store page or website

premiere.name: Premiere
premiere.desc: Priority placement and a richer listing.
premiere.f3: Extended description in your details view
premiere.f4: Up to three links: App Store, Google Play and website

blockbuster.name: Blockbuster
blockbuster.desc: Top billing for apps that want the front row.
blockbuster.f3: Rotation in the “Tonight's headliner” spot on the home page

tickets.trust2: Full refund within 14 days of your first payment
tickets.renewNote: Plans renew automatically every month until you cancel. Cancellation and refunds are explained in our <1>Refund Policy</1>.

faq.title: Before the lights go down
faq.a1: {brand} is an online showcase where app publishers pay a monthly fee to present their apps to visitors. Think of it as a small cinema for apps: a curated programme, presented with care.
faq.q2: How do I get my app listed?
faq.a2: Choose a ticket, fill in the short submission form and we will review your app. Once it is approved and payment is completed, your poster goes live.
faq.a3: Plans are billed monthly in advance through a secure third-party payment provider. We never see or store your card details.
faq.a4: Yes, at any time. Your listing stays online until the end of the period you have already paid for, and you will not be charged again.
faq.a5: Our Refund Policy explains when refunds apply, including the withdrawal rights that consumers have in some countries. It is linked at the bottom of every page.
faq.a6: Lawful apps that are available to the public and follow our Content Guidelines. We do not list apps that are deceptive, malicious, hateful or sexually explicit, or that target children unlawfully. We may decline or remove a listing at our discretion.
faq.a7: No, and you should be careful with anyone who does. We sell visibility on our stage, not results. How many people install your app depends on the app, the audience and many things outside our control.
faq.a8: Always. Every paid placement shows a “Sponsored” label so visitors know exactly what they are looking at.
faq.a9: No. We do not use advertising or profiling cookies. The site remembers only your language, motion and privacy choices, and it keeps them on your own device.
faq.a10: The site is available in English, Hebrew, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Japanese. You can provide your listing text in any of them.

finale.lead: The stage is set and the projector is warm. All that is missing is your app.

share.title: Know an app that deserves a premiere?
share.text: Send its maker an invitation. Good apps should not sit in the back row.
share.message: {brand}: a cinematic stage for apps. Every app deserves a premiere.

All other names and marks belong to their respective owners. {brand} is an independent service and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Apple, Google or any listed publisher.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.textBasic: This site uses only the storage it strictly needs to work: your language, motion and privacy choices, kept on your own device. No advertising cookies. No tracking.
consent.textFull: We use essential storage to make the site work. With your permission we would also like to use privacy-friendly analytics to understand how the site is used. You can change your choice at any time.
consent.dialogIntro: Choose what this site may store on your device. Your choice is saved on this device only.
consent.necessaryText: Remembers your language, your motion preference and your privacy choices. Always on, because the site cannot work properly without it.
consent.analyticsText: Anonymous, aggregated statistics that help us improve the site. Off unless you turn it on.
consent.analyticsNone: Not in use on this site at the moment.
consent.gpc: Your browser sent a Global Privacy Control signal. We honour it: optional storage stays off.
consent.saved: Your privacy choices have been saved.

submit.title: Submit your app
submit.lead: Tell us about your app. We review every submission by hand and reply by email.
submit.appUrlHint: App Store, Google Play or your website. It must start with https://
submit.name: Your name
submit.emailHint: We use it only to reply about this submission.
submit.cRights: I confirm that I own this app or am authorised to promote it, and that everything I submit is accurate and does not infringe anyone's rights.
submit.cTerms: I have read and agree to the <1>Terms of Service</1> and the <2>Content Guidelines</2>.
submit.cAge: I am at least 18 years old.
submit.privacyNote: We use the details above only to review your submission and to contact you about it. See our <1>Privacy Policy</1>.
submit.errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
submit.errUrl: Please enter a valid link that starts with https://
submit.errTooLong: This is too long. The maximum is {max} characters.
submit.errCheck: Please tick this box to continue.
submit.errSummary: Please correct the highlighted fields and try again.
submit.errNetwork: Something went wrong and your submission was not sent. Please try again in a moment.
submit.errTooFast: That was quick. Please review your details and send again.
submit.errFramed: For your security, this form cannot be used inside another website. Please open it in its own tab.
submit.noscript: This form needs JavaScript. Please enable it in your browser, or contact us using the details on our Legal Notice page.
submit.closedText: We are putting the final touches on the stage. Please check back shortly.
submit.successTitle: Thank you. We have your submission.
submit.successText: We will review your app and reply by email.
submit.successPay: You can complete your payment now through our secure payment provider. Your listing goes live once your app is approved.
submit.successPayLater: After approval we will email you a secure payment link.
submit.mailText: Your email app should now open with your submission ready to send. If nothing happened, copy the details below and email them to us.

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.text: Your payment is being handled by our payment provider, and you will receive a receipt by email. If you have not sent us your app details yet, please submit them now.

notFound.title: Scene missing
notFound.text: This reel seems to have been cut from the film. Let us take you back to the main feature.
